name: Low-vol-armed trend continuation (calm-tape momentum)
rationale: THESIS: trend/momentum only persists in calm regimes; in high-vol tapes price overshoots and whipsaws, so plain momentum fires in chop where it bleeds. We arm the long-only trend ONLY when realized vol sits below a fitted calm ceiling (vol_realized is BOUNDED so a level threshold binds) AND medium-term return is positive. The vol gate is the orthogonal structure, not the trend. DISCONFIRMER: run the IDENTICAL ret_Nd>0 rule with the vol_realized<ceiling gate REMOVED (trend-alone). If gated and ungated produce statistically indistinguishable deflated-Sharpe net of fees, the calm-vol gate adds nothing and this is just already-exhausted momentum. The gate must add risk-adjusted return after the extra turnover from vol-regime exits.
catalyst: Realized vol drops below a fitted calm ceiling while medium-term price trend is already up — a quiet, persistent tape that momentum survives.
